name: Safari World Bangkok
tagline: Starter safari: zebra, orangutan show, and giraffe — live site is thin; no shark card.

practical.best_start: Safari OR Marine Park first — not both deep.

items.label: Zebra
items.one_liner: Safari Park zebra — every stripe set is unique.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Zebra?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Orangutan
items.one_liner: Orangutan show — long arms, watch the hands.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Orangutan?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Giraffe
items.one_liner: Safari Park giraffe — look up from the tram.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Giraffe?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.presence_note: Official investor PDF: giraffe. Soft Giraffe.

items.label: Lion
items.one_liner: Lions on the open safari — listen for a roar.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Lion?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.presence_note: Official PDF: lions / white lion. Soft Lion.

items.label: River / lake fish

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the River / lake fish?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

Orangutan: hands or feet doing the clever bit?
